crossRefs.note: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add…
The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple…
“You shall make an altar to burn incense on. You shall make it of acacia wood.
Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.
The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

translations.web: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.
translations.bsb: And the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of the saints, rose up before God from the hand of the angel.
translations.kjv: And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel's hand.
translations.asv: And the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel's hand.
